# Status

<!-- Generated by `pnpm run status` (scripts/status.mjs). Do not edit by hand. -->

Generated from the behaviour scenarios in [`apps/camNC/e2e/spec/scenarios`](../apps/camNC/e2e/spec/scenarios), the checklist in [`docs/status-checklist.json`](../docs/status-checklist.json), the performance gates the root `test:performance` script runs, and the floors in [`scripts/status-floors.json`](../scripts/status-floors.json). Edit those, then run `pnpm run status`. CI fails if this file is stale.

Passing these checks shows their stated coverage, not complete CAD tool coverage or a physical machining run. To run them, see the [browser regression recipes](../apps/camNC/e2e/cad/README.md), the [behaviour specs](../apps/camNC/e2e/spec/README.md) and [TESTING.md](TESTING.md).

## Known gaps

Pick work from here. Fixing a gap means removing its `known` marker or moving its checklist row on, and regenerating this file.

No spec is marked as a known gap.

Checklist gaps:

| Area                 | Item                                                      | Note                                                                                                                                  |
| -------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Part Studio features | Split a part by a plane                                   | Sketch-edge splitting and split joints exist; splitting a solid part into separate boards is not implemented.                         |
| Part Studio features | Circular pattern of parts                                 | Circular sketch patterns exist; the part pattern is linear only.                                                                      |
| Part Studio features | Boolean Union and Intersect between existing parts        | Cut parts subtracts tools from targets; existing bodies cannot be joined or intersected by a Boolean feature.                         |
| Part Studio features | Measure and section view in the Part Studio               | Sketch measurements exist. Measuring and sectioning the assembled parts are not available.                                            |
| Part Studio features | Variable types and ordered definitions                    | Variables are inferred from expressions and apply globally; explicit types, measured values and positional scope are not implemented. |
| Part Studio features | Sketch on an edge face, end-grain holes and angled joints | Deferred: only polygons from the top, the underside and pocket floors are modelled (docs/CAD_ROADMAP.md).                             |
| Sketch tools         | Normal, Pierce and Equal curvature constraints            | Their shortcuts say the constraint isn't available yet.                                                                               |
| Machine              | A side B program cut on the machine                       | Not tried on a real machine yet.                                                                                                      |

## Performance gates

Run by `pnpm run test:performance`, the "Performance gates" CI step, on a runner whose functional tests have finished. Each budget is the test’s own `toBeLessThan` limit.

| Package      | Test file                                                                                                                       | Gate                                                                                                            | Budget               |
| ------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------- |
| @wbcnc/cam   | [`packages/cam/src/settle.test.ts`](../packages/cam/src/settle.test.ts)                                                         | runs fast enough for a pointer on real outlines                                                                 | < 120 ms             |
| @wbcnc/cam   | [`packages/cam/src/settle.test.ts`](../packages/cam/src/settle.test.ts)                                                         | stays quick on a tray of many parts, and finds the same offcut                                                  | < 50 ms              |
| @wbcnc/cam   | [`packages/cam/src/settle.test.ts`](../packages/cam/src/settle.test.ts)                                                         | suggests holds on real outlines within a fixed multiple of reference work                                       | < 6 × reference work |
| @wbcnc/cam   | [`packages/cam/src/settle.test.ts`](../packages/cam/src/settle.test.ts)                                                         | falls back on a full sheet of %i parts within a fixed multiple of reference work (each of `[32, 72, 144, 288]`) | < 6 × reference work |
| @wbcnc/camNC | [`apps/camNC/src/cam/boards.test.ts`](../apps/camNC/src/cam/boards.test.ts)                                                     | nests 30 parts fast: within a set multiple of a fixed piece of work timed alongside                             | < 5 × reference work |
